📈 **Hospital stocks surge up to 4%** after India confirms 3 cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV)). 

Investors flock to healthcare amid virus concerns, with **Narayana Hrudayalaya** hitting a day's high of Rs 1,355. 🏥📊
